Question: Does back-to-back fatigue reduce scoring? (MIN>20, within-player)
Interpretation: Within-player analysis (321 players, MIN>20): B2B games does not reduce (or slightly increases) scoring by 0.01 pts on average (mean diff=+0.01, CI=[-5.64,5.67], not significant at α=0.05). Test: paired t (within-player).
